protocol.name: song_s04_cue_relative_event_audit_v1
protocol.eligible_events: completed valid formal trials with at least one 200 ms model window wholly inside the recorded stable cue interval
protocol.decoder: existing SongOnlineDecision with threshold 0.5 and three consecutive 100 ms frames, replayed continuously over all S04 raw packets
protocol.late_rest: 200 ms model windows wholly inside the final 400 ms before each formal prompt; any decoded active label counts as a pre-prompt activation for that trial
protocol.active_event_success: at least one decoded matching hand state within the full-window stable cue interval
protocol.active_event_endpoint: last full-window stable frame has the correct decoded hand state
protocol.cue_relative_first_correct_seconds: (end sample index of first correct decoded full-window stable frame minus stable_start_sample) / 250; only successful non-neutral events
protocol.neutral_event: report matching-decoded-frame and endpoint fractions separately; no active onset latency
protocol.limitations: Cue and stable sample markers are collection annotations, not measured physiological movement onset; frame delay includes 200 ms window formation and decoder persistence. This is saved-signal offline replay, not USB, screen or product latency.
